pricing.details: 14-day free trial, no card, cancel anytime. 133 € per agent per month (1 agent = 1 open role; add agents to run more roles in parallel). The official /pricing path is a 404; this is the only public paid amount, stated on the homepage. Homepage inclusions: unlimited email and phone credits, search across 800M+ profiles, match-scored ranking, AI-drafted outreach.
